days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Berchtesgaden National Park
stops.detail: Röthbach Waterfall in Berchtesgaden National Park plunges over a height of 470 metres, cascading down the rock and overcoming two large steps.

stops.name: Landtal Waterfall
stops.detail: A little to the north, another impressive cascade spills down into the depths: the 410-metre Landtal Waterfall, the second highest waterfall in Germany.

stops.name: Röth
stops.detail: The mighty rock barrier, up to 700 metres high, separates the basin of Königsee Lake from the Röth, a plateau that stretches between the Steinernes Meer and the Hagengebirge mountains.

stops.name: Saletalm
stops.detail: You can reach Röthbach Waterfall by taking a boat trip across Königssee Lake to the Saletalm exit.
